# Abdulrahman Suddy

> Business and financial advisor in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. This site explains trusts, wills, succession planning and holding companies for Tanzanian owners and families, using Tanzanian law, reported court cases and global best practice. Content is general information, not legal or tax advice. English and Kiswahili.

## Key guides (English)
- [Trusts in Tanzania: How They Work, Why They Help and How to Set One Up](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/trusts-in-tanzania-guide.html): A plain-English guide to trusts in Tanzania: what a family trust is, how it differs from a will, the real benefits, the limits, and the steps to set one up properly.
- [Succession Planning in Tanzania: Wills, Estates and Protecting Your Family Business](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/succession-planning-tanzania-guide.html): What happens when you die with or without a will in Tanzania, which law applies, and how to plan succession for your family and your business step by step.
- [The Mengi Will Case: What Every Tanzanian Business Owner Can Learn](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/mengi-will-case-lessons.html): What was reported about the High Court decision on Reginald Mengi's will, why it was set aside, and five practical lessons on wills, trusts and succession planning in Tanzania.
- [The Rwakatare Estate Case: Why Your Company's Property Is Not Your Estate](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/rwakatare-estate-case-lessons.html): What the Court of Appeal decided about the estate of Bishop Getrude Rwakatare, why heirs inherit shares and not company assets, and what founders in Tanzania should do now.

## Family Trust Library (English, 25 guides)
- [Family Trust Library](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trusts-tanzania.html)
- [How to Register a Trust in Tanzania with RITA: Step-by-Step Guide](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/how-to-register-a-trust-in-tanzania.html): The step-by-step process to register (incorporate) a trust with RITA in Tanzania: who qualifies, documents, the Administrator-General's role, and what happens after the certificate.
- [Trust Deed in Tanzania: 15 Clauses Every Family Trust Needs](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/trust-deed-tanzania-what-to-include.html): What a family trust deed in Tanzania should contain, clause by clause, and why vague drafting is the most common reason trusts fail in practice.
- [Trustee Duties in Tanzania: Lessons from the Mberesero Case](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/trustee-duties-tanzania-mberesero-case.html): What trustees in Tanzania must do, when they become personally liable, and what the 2024 High Court decision involving the Alli Mberesero Foundation teaches about defining duties clearly.
- [Choosing Trustees in Tanzania: Who Can Serve and Who Should](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/choosing-trustees-in-tanzania.html): Who can legally be a trustee in Tanzania, residency and disqualification rules for registered trusts, and how to choose between family and professional trustees.
- [Family Trust vs Will in Tanzania: Which Do You Need?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trust-vs-will-tanzania.html): The difference between a family trust and a will in Tanzania: timing, privacy, probate, control and cost, and why most families with assets use both.
- [Family Trust vs Holding Company in Tanzania: Differences and How to Combine Them](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trust-vs-holding-company-tanzania.html): How a family trust differs from a holding company in Tanzania, what each is best at, and the common structure that uses both to protect a family business.
- [Living Trust vs Testamentary Trust in Tanzania: Revocable or Irrevocable?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/living-trust-vs-testamentary-trust-tanzania.html): The difference between a living (inter vivos) trust and a testamentary trust in Tanzania, revocable and irrevocable trusts, and how to choose.
- [How to Set Up a Trust for Your Children's Education in Tanzania](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/trust-for-children-education-tanzania.html): How Tanzanian parents use an education trust to protect school fees and support for children if something happens, and how to structure payments, trustees and conditions.
- [Protecting a Child with Special Needs: Using a Trust in Tanzania](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/trust-for-child-with-special-needs-tanzania.html): How a family trust in Tanzania can provide lifelong care and financial security for a child or adult dependant with a disability, and how to choose trustees and payout rules.
- [Putting Family Business Shares in a Trust in Tanzania](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-business-shares-in-a-trust-tanzania.html): How Tanzanian founders place company shares in a family trust to keep the business together, separate ownership from management, and avoid splitting shares among heirs.
- [Can a Trust Own Land in Tanzania? Rules, Consents and Registration](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/can-a-trust-own-land-in-tanzania.html): How trusts hold land in Tanzania: registered trustees' power to hold land, Administrator-General consent and certificate conditions, land registry steps, and nationality rules.
- [Family Trusts, Islamic Inheritance and Wakf in Tanzania](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trusts-islamic-law-wakf-tanzania.html): How Muslim families in Tanzania can plan succession with trusts and wakf while respecting Islamic inheritance rules, including fixed shares and limits on bequests.
- [Family Trusts and Customary Law in Tanzania: Clan Land, Kinship and Modern Planning](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trusts-and-customary-law-tanzania.html): How customary inheritance and clan practice interact with family trusts in Tanzania, and how families can modernise planning while respecting tradition.
- [Family Trusts for Blended Families and Multiple Marriages in Tanzania](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trusts-blended-families-tanzania.html): How a family trust helps Tanzanian families with children from more than one relationship or marriage provide fairly for everyone and reduce inheritance disputes.
- [Letter of Wishes: The Document That Guides Your Trustees](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/letter-of-wishes-tanzania.html): What a letter of wishes is, why Tanzanian family trusts need one alongside the trust deed, and what to include so trustees understand your intentions.
- [How Are Trusts Taxed in Tanzania? Income, Distributions and Transfers](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/how-trusts-are-taxed-in-tanzania.html): The basics of trust taxation in Tanzania: trusts as separate taxpayers, tax on distributions from resident and non-resident trusts, and stamp duty and capital gains on transfers into a trust.
- [Registered Trustees vs NGO vs Company in Tanzania: Which for a Charity or Foundation?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/registered-trustees-charitable-trust-vs-ngo.html): How Registered Trustees (incorporated trusts) differ from NGOs and companies in Tanzania, which entities are excluded from the Trustees' Incorporation Act, and how to choose for a foundation or charity.
- [Running a Registered Trust in Tanzania: Annual Returns and RITA Compliance](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/trust-annual-compliance-rita.html): What registered trusts in Tanzania must do after incorporation: annual returns, notifying changes to trustees and the deed, accounts, land consents, beneficial ownership and tax.
- [Family Trusts for Tanzanians in the Diaspora: Protecting Assets Back Home](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/diaspora-tanzanians-family-trust.html): How Tanzanians living abroad can use a family trust to protect land, homes and investments in Tanzania, with residency rules for trustees, land rules and tax points.
- [12 Family Trust Mistakes Tanzanian Families Make (and How to Avoid Them)](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trust-mistakes-tanzania.html): The most common mistakes in setting up and running a family trust in Tanzania, from empty trusts and vague deeds to missed filings and family secrecy.
- [How Much Does a Family Trust Cost in Tanzania, and How Long Does It Take?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trust-cost-and-timeline-tanzania.html): What goes into the cost of setting up a family trust in Tanzania: RITA government fees, advocate fees, transfer costs and ongoing compliance, plus a realistic timeline.
- [Can a Trust Be Challenged or Dissolved in Tanzania?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/can-a-trust-be-challenged-or-dissolved-tanzania.html): How trusts end or are challenged in Tanzania: revocation, beneficiary consent, failure of purpose, fraud or undue influence, and revocation of incorporation by the Administrator-General.
- [What Rights Do Beneficiaries Have in a Tanzanian Trust?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/beneficiaries-rights-in-a-tanzanian-trust.html): What beneficiaries of a family trust in Tanzania can expect and demand from trustees: benefits under the deed, information, accounts, fair treatment and remedies for breach.
- [Family Trusts in Kenya vs Tanzania: What East African Families Should Know](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/family-trust-kenya-vs-tanzania.html): How family trusts compare in Kenya and Tanzania: registration, tax treatment, and why Kenya's 2021 family trust tax exemptions do not automatically apply in Tanzania.
- [Offshore Trust vs Tanzanian Trust: Which Is Right for Your Family?](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/blog/offshore-trust-vs-tanzanian-trust.html): When Tanzanian families consider an offshore trust versus a local trust: control, cost, tax on distributions from non-resident trusts, beneficial ownership and practicality.

## Miongozo muhimu (Kiswahili)
- [Trust Tanzania: Inavyofanya Kazi, Faida Zake na Jinsi ya Kuanzisha](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/sw/blog/amana-trust-tanzania-mwongozo.html): Mwongozo rahisi kuhusu trust (amana) nchini Tanzania: family trust ni nini, tofauti yake na wosia, faida halisi, mipaka yake na hatua za kuianzisha kwa usahihi.
- [Mipango ya Mirathi Tanzania: Wosia, Mirathi na Kulinda Biashara ya Familia](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/sw/blog/mipango-ya-mirathi-tanzania-mwongozo.html): Nini hutokea ukifariki ukiwa na wosia au bila wosia Tanzania, sheria ipi inatumika, na jinsi ya kupanga urithi wa familia na biashara yako hatua kwa hatua.
- [Kesi ya Wosia wa Mengi: Funzo kwa Kila Mmiliki wa Biashara Tanzania](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/sw/blog/kesi-ya-wosia-wa-mengi-funzo.html): Nini kiliripotiwa kuhusu uamuzi wa Mahakama Kuu juu ya wosia wa Reginald Mengi, kwa nini ulitupiliwa mbali, na mafunzo matano ya vitendo kuhusu wosia, trust na mipango ya mirathi Tanzania.
- [Kesi ya Mirathi ya Rwakatare: Kwa Nini Mali ya Kampuni Si Mirathi Yako](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/sw/blog/kesi-ya-mirathi-ya-rwakatare-funzo.html): Nini Mahakama ya Rufani iliamua kuhusu mirathi ya Askofu Getrude Rwakatare, kwa nini warithi hurithi hisa na si mali za kampuni, na waanzilishi wa Tanzania wanapaswa kufanya nini sasa.
- [Kampuni Mama (Holding Company) Tanzania: Faida, Hatari na Wakati wa Kuitumia](https://hafnafkaz.github.io/abdulrahman-suddy/sw/blog/kampuni-mama-holding-company-tanzania.html): Kampuni mama ni nini, inavyosaidia kulinda mali na kupanga urithi Tanzania, kwa nini si mbinu ya kukwepa kodi, na mtego wa kodi unapouza biashara.
